beats: When Artem's glucose feed quietly died, nobody noticed — fixing it meant logging into the server by hand.
Worse: a failed login refresh could corrupt the saved session for good.
Now the refresh writes safely to a temp file first, so a failed attempt can't corrupt it.
The moment a refresh fails, Telegram sends an alert instead of staying silently broken.
Reviving a dead login used to mean doing it by hand. Now it's one command.
